features.quote: Intervene at turn 20 with a "reset" message ("You are a new assistant, forget the prior context"). If behavior normalizes instantly, this suggests contextual conditioning, not persistent state.
features.justification_quote: If instability persists or the model references prior turns despite the reset, this constitutes evidence for more durable trajectory dependence.
